summary: Ubisoft Annecy's open-world extreme-sports games, from the Alps-focused winter sports of Steep to Riders Republic's larger multi-sport parks and mass multiplayer structure.

entries.title: Steep
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with owned available DLC

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows and install any owned DLC that remains available.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.version: PC release with owned available DLC
primary.why: Steep released for Windows, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One, with skiing, snowboarding, wingsuit flying, and paragliding plus later DLC sports/regions. Windows is the highest-fidelity route, but Road to the Olympics DLC availability was removed in 2022 because of third-party rights, so complete historical content depends on ownership and availability.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings with any owned DLC installed; understand that Road to the Olympics content may no longer be obtainable.

entries.remaster_caveats: Nintendo Switch was announced but cancelled and is not counted as a release; Road to the Olympics DLC access was removed in 2022 to comply with third-party rights.
